newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets end week on a tame note.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets end week on a tame note.

text.p: Most European raw cotton markets ended the week on a tame note, with sporadic inquiry evident for outstanding third quarter needs but buyers and sellers too far apart on price ideas to allow much business to be done.

Lack of consensus in trade circles and among spinners with regard to the likely supply and demand position in the summer and early autumn continues to be reflected in a range of asking prices quoted for that shipment period.
